name: Louisiana

context: LA 340: Louisiana lists wind erosion among cover crop purposes; cover crops are timed to protect soil in critical erosion periods.
LA 340: Short-season cover crops can give short term wind erosion protection until the main crop is established.
cover_rules: LA 340: Maximize combined canopy and surface residue cover to a minimum of 90-percent cover during the period of potentially erosive wind or rainfall.
LA 340: In mixes, the proportional rates must sum to more than 100%; do not include ryegrass in Louisiana cover crop mixtures.
residue: LA 329: Maintain a minimum of 60 percent residue cover (flat) on the soil surface when not covered by living plant canopy.

cover.name: Sunn hemp
cover.note: Broadcast or drilled; plant on raised beds in southern Louisiana.

cover.note: Full seeding rate used in the mixture example.

cover.note: Full seeding rate used in the mixture example.

coverPlant.text: LA 340: Tropic Sun sunn hemp on sugarcane fallow fields is planted in April or May at 30 PLS lb/ac and terminated 60 days after planting.
